description: This file defines configuration structures and types for the Kubernetes kube-proxy component, including settings for iptables, ipvs, nftables, conntrack, and Windows kernel configurations, as well as detection modes and proxy modes.

classes.description: Configuration settings for ipvs proxy mode in kube-proxy.

classes.description: Settings for detecting local traffic modes.

classes.name: KubeProxyConfiguration
